lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: Welcome to Dimension-Y, little putters. My stone generals have already taken their positions. They do not blink. They do not miss.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Generals made of rock. Cute. I have beaten worse with a seven iron and a bad attitude.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: Your iron cannot cut what is already broken. I am Slicer. I have been waiting for a worthy slice.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Careful, May. The wind here has teeth, and the void does not give mulligans. Keep your shell- er, your head- down.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: The ooze that remade me has shown me the truth. There is no rough here, only the long dark between shots.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then we will play the long dark. Caddy, call the line.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Aim through the gaps, not at the wall. And if the big one starts counting, hit him before he finishes.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: Count with me. When I reach zero, your little tee becomes a crater.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: The Foot has already surrounded this dimension. You are three lives from the sewer, golfers.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Three lives is plenty. I once saved a whole city with a two-stroke penalty.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: She means she saved it from a very boring afternoon. Now swing like the wind owes you money.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: Then swing, turtle. My generals are waiting, and they are hungry.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: So this is the golfer who keeps slipping through the portals. I expected a warrior. I got a bag of clubs.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: You got the clubs, too. Step into range and I will show you what a sand wedge thinks of your armor.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: Do not taunt her, Slicer. The ooze taught me patience. The darkness taught me hunger. She is only a shell away from both.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Cortex. You used to be a scientist with a bad haircut. Now you are a demon with a worse tailor.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: I traded a lab coat for a throne of wind and stone. My stone generals answer only to me.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then they can answer me with a divot. Caddy, how do we break a demon?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Same way we break a wind field. Find the gap, use the spin, and never let him finish his swing. Hit him while he charges.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: My missiles remember every tee. They will find yours even in the dark.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: They can try. I have dodged worse things than guided shots.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: You misunderstand. This is not a game. This is the last hole of your little sewer world.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Good. I hate long goodbyes. May, drop him before he drops the void on us.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: On it. Cowabunga, demon.
